csv_project_name: A/E Service for Herbert C. Hoover Building
csv_agency: Dept of Commerce - Office of Acquisition
csv_scope_of_work: This procurement will result in single or multiple awards of Firm Fixed Price (FFP) Indefinite-Delivery-Indefinite-Quantity (IDIQ) contracts, for multi discipline A E services for planning, studies/assessments, and/or design of renovation projects. The requirement of the Architect-Engineer (A-E) IDIQ is to provide professional architectural and engineering design services and technical advisory support to assist the Government in the planning design, and development of facility and infrastructure projects. Projects may include single or multiple disciplines, such as: structural, civil, mechanical, plumbing, electrical, architectural, planning, environmental, fire protection, and cost estimating. The types of projects may include, interior building renovations, failure investigation including destructive and non destructive testing, structural engineering investigations, utility systems including sanitary and storm, water systems, storm water management, electrical and mechanical design for renovations.
